title: Enforce reflex grant derivation and containment (VC-201-075)
goal: VC-201-075 refuted: GrantSet.caps is a public BTreeSet — a reflex can grant itself any capability after attenuation; grants are intersected with a hardcoded list, not derived from the parent mission; there are no memory/fuel/time dimensions at all; GrantSet has no callers outside tests so nothing consults the grant set at run time. Evidence: crates/susi-core/src/tests/vc_201_075_mastery.rs.
